body:
That means that if we are using `--update-all-dependencies` option in `/fix` command we must include paragraph in the issue description, that all general logic or duplicated code or missing features or bugs that lead to workarounds in the code must be reported to upstream of dependencies, yet we can keep workarounds at the same time to not block the pull request.

`--report-dependencies-issues` is needed to have ability to disable that option if needed separately.

So the end results would be that in the moment of dependencies update all our dependencies will get their feedback and will be able to improve up on, so we making everything better step by step.

We need to collect data related about the issue to this repository, make sure we compile that data to `./docs/case-studies/issue-{id}` folder, and use it to do deep case study analysis (also make sure to search online for additional facts and data), list of each and all requirements from the issue, and propose possible solutions and solution plans for each requirement (we should also check known existing components/libraries, that solve similar problem or can help in solutions).

Please plan and execute everything in this single pull request, you have unlimited time and context, as context auto-compacts and you can continue indefinitely, until each and every requirement fully addressed, and everything is totally done.
title: `--update-all-dependencies` must activate `--report-dependencies-issues` option by default
